title: John Glenn urged Harry Reid to investigate UFOs

tellings.quote: Glenn who urged Harry Reid to investigate UFOs as part of Asa

plain: The astronaut and senator John Glenn pushed Harry Reid, the Senate leader, to look into UFOs, which fed into a Pentagon-funded UFO study program whose name the transcript catches only as "Asa." Michels says this himself in a documentary episode, without naming a source. If true, it would mean one of America's most trusted astronauts helped start the government's modern UFO research.
